summary: Iteration 22 — Fresh DB reset validation after import. Verified super admin seeding, legacy demo accounts removed, super admin can create users/classes/books, PPDB public register & admin list works, forgot-password returns generic 200 and actually sent email via Emergent proxy (backend log 'Reset email sent to boassibarani123@gmail.com'). Frontend: login page shows no 'Coba Akun Demo' section; headline is above school-info card (headline_y=120, card_y=382); all 5 public links present under form (Presentasi/Struktur Organisasi/Dokumentasi/Galeri/PPDB) + Lupa password + Lihat Profil Sekolah. Student ID card barcode front measured height=44px, width=229px (height=40 + margin×2, barWidth=2.5) — fills the white box as requested. All 12 protected pages load without crash on empty data. 16/16 backend tests passed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~3900 lines — splitting into routers (auth, users, classes, attendance, library, kas, ppdb, email, settings) will significantly reduce coupling and simplify future audits.

Legacy demo removal in _seed() uses a hard-coded email list (line 3634); as new tenants onboard this will become dead code. Consider a one-shot migration script and dropping the deletion from startup.
forgot-password endpoint does not rate-limit per IP (only per email within 15 min). Trivial to enumerate at scale; add IP-based throttling.
send_reset_email logs full recipient at INFO level; consider masking (b***@gmail.com) to avoid PII leakage in supervisor logs.
test_credentials: boassibarani123@gmail.com / Boas12345io (only account in DB besides seeded settings)
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_guru_*, TEST_tu_*, TEST_siswa_* users, one X-TEST-* class, one TEST Buku, and one PPDB applicant via tests. Safe to delete.
